slides.title: Conditional inversion
slides.subtitle: Had I known… / Should you need… / Were it not for…
goals: Replace *if* with inversion in formal style.
Use **were it not for / had it not been for**.

slides.title: Form and use

head: Standard
Inverted
rows: If I had known, I would have come.
**Had I known**, I would have come.
If you should need help, call me.
If I were in your position…
If it weren't for your help…
If it hadn't been for the rain…
**Had it not been for** the rain…

slides.tip: Negative inversion has no contraction: *Had I not…*, not *Hadn't I…*

items.q: ___ you require further information, please contact us.
___ I known about the strike, I would have stayed home.
___ it not for her support, I would have quit.

items.t: ___ it not been for the GPS, we'd have got lost.
___ the weather improve, the event will go ahead.
